glosses.notes: Used for shutting something such as a door, eyes, or a place of business.

examples.sentence: 会一结束，工作人员就把后门闭上了，免得外面等着进场的人一下子都挤进来。
医生让他先把眼睛轻轻闭一会儿，再慢慢说清楚刚才到底是从什么时候开始头晕的。
这家店平时十点才闭门，可是昨天晚上灯突然都黑了，老板只好先请店里的人明天再来。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the meeting ended, the staff shut the back door so the people waiting outside to enter would not all squeeze in at once.
The doctor told him to close his eyes gently for a moment first, then slowly explain exactly when the dizziness had started.
This shop usually closes at ten, but the lights suddenly went out last night, so the owner had to ask the people still inside to come back tomorrow.

glosses.notes: Means avoiding a person, topic, danger, or crowded situation, often by steering clear of it.

examples.sentence: 为了避开下班高峰，他把会改到早上，还提醒外地来的同事早点出门，别在路上堵太久。
她本来想当面谈清楚，可是一看见父亲坐在客厅里脸色不好，就又回避了这个话题。
雨突然下大以后，路边卖水果的人都把车往里推，先避一避再说，连钱都顾不上收。

example_translations.translation: To avoid the evening rush, he moved the meeting to the morning and reminded the coworkers coming from farther away to leave early so they would not get stuck on the road too long.
She had wanted to talk it through face to face, but when she saw her father sitting in the living room looking unhappy, she avoided the topic again.
After the rain suddenly got heavier, the people selling fruit by the road pushed their carts inward to take cover first and did not even have time to collect the money.

glosses.notes: Describes a course, task, or training that everyone has to take or complete.

examples.sentence: 这门课虽然是大一的必修课，可是真正让学生头疼的不是考试，而是每周都要按时交的实验记录。
学校把安全训练列成了新生的必修内容，所以连平时最怕麻烦的人也得先去操场报到。
他原来以为实习只是老师建议，不料后来才知道这是毕业前谁也不能跳过的必修环节。

example_translations.translation: Although this is a required first-year course, what really gives the students a headache is not the exam, but the lab records they have to hand in on time every week.
The school made safety training a required part of orientation, so even the people who hate trouble the most still had to report to the field first.
He had originally thought the internship was only a teacher's suggestion, but later found out that it was a required step nobody could skip before graduation.

glosses.notes: Can mean weaving something, inventing a story or excuse, or putting written material together.

examples.sentence: 爷爷年轻时会自己编网，现在手慢了，可是一到夏天还是喜欢坐在门口慢慢编。
孩子怕老师问，就临时编了个理由，说作业忘在家里了，其实本子一直放在书包里。
这套教材不是一个人编出来的，几位老师前后改了很多次，才把难度慢慢调顺。

example_translations.translation: Grandpa used to weave nets by himself when he was younger. His hands are slower now, but every summer he still likes to sit by the doorway and keep weaving slowly.
The child was afraid the teacher would ask, so he made up an excuse on the spot, saying he had left his homework at home even though the notebook had been in his schoolbag the whole time.
This set of teaching materials was not compiled by one person; several teachers revised it many times before the difficulty finally became smoother.

glosses.notes: Can mean editing text or video, and also the person whose job is to do that work.

examples.sentence: 这段采访剪得太乱，老师让他重新编辑一下，不然大家根本听不明白前后发生了什么。
她白天在报社做编辑，晚上回家以后还要再看一遍第二天准备发出的稿子。
老编辑一看标题就知道问题在哪儿，拿起笔改了几处以后，整篇文章立刻顺了很多。

example_translations.translation: This interview was cut so messily that the teacher told him to edit it again, otherwise everyone would have trouble understanding what had happened before and after.
She works as an editor at the newspaper during the day, and after she gets home at night, she still has to read through the copy for the next day one more time.
The senior editor could tell what was wrong the moment he saw the title. After changing a few spots with his pen, the whole article immediately read much more smoothly.

glosses.notes: A formal verb for writing or drafting material such as manuals, scripts, or other written content.

examples.sentence: 公司请他编写新的操作说明，就是怕新来的员工只听口头安排会漏掉关键步骤。
这部剧本前后编写了两年，中间换过好几次结尾，最后才定成现在大家看到的样子。
老师让我们分组编写调查问题，先把要问的话排好，明天出去访问时才不会乱。

example_translations.translation: The company asked him to write the new operating instructions because they were afraid new employees would miss key steps if they only listened to verbal directions.
This script was written over the course of two years. The ending was changed several times before it was finally settled into the version people see now.
The teacher asked us to work in groups to write the survey questions, putting the questions in order first so we would not get confused during tomorrow's interviews.

glosses.notes: Describes things spreading across the ground or appearing all over an area.

examples.sentence: 风一停，院子里的叶子还是遍地都是，门口刚清出来一点，转眼又被吹回来了。
春天一到，山脚下的野花遍地开，很多人吃完早饭就带着孩子过去拍照。
路还没修好的时候，门外就已经遍地是土，大家走几步鞋上都是灰。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the wind stopped, leaves were still all over the courtyard. The entrance had only just been cleared a little when another layer blew back in.
As soon as spring arrives, wildflowers bloom all over the foot of the mountain, and many people bring their children there for photos after breakfast.
Before the road was fully repaired, the ground outside was covered with dirt, and after only a few steps everyone's shoes were dusty.

glosses.notes: Describes a service, route, or process as easy and efficient to use.

examples.sentence: 以前去医院挂号要排很久，现在手机上先填资料，到了门口直接取号，整个过程便捷了不少。
这条新开的公交线虽然不算快，可是把学校、车站和市场都连起来了，大家买东西比以前便捷多了。
公司把报名步骤改得更便捷以后，连最怕填表的人也能自己把材料一次交完。

example_translations.translation: Going to the hospital used to mean waiting in line for a long time. Now you fill in your information on your phone first and just take a number at the door, so the whole process is much more convenient.
This new bus line is not especially fast, but it connects the school, the station, and the market, so shopping is much more convenient than before.
After the company made the registration steps more convenient, even the people who hate filling out forms could submit all the materials on their own in one go.

glosses.notes: Used when food, medicine, or even a relationship changes for the worse and is no longer sound.

examples.sentence: 牛奶放了大半天以后，妈妈晚上打开一闻，就怕天太热，它已经变质了。
这份合作原来只是意见不同，可是一牵到钱，气氛就慢慢变质，连平时最冷静的人也开始吵起来。
药放在窗边晒了太久以后可能会变质，所以护士一看见有人随手乱放，就马上提醒别再照太阳。

example_translations.translation: After the milk had been sitting out for most of the day, Mom opened it and smelled it that night, worried that in this heat it had already gone bad.
At first this partnership only involved a difference of opinion, but once money became part of it, the atmosphere started to deteriorate, and even the calmest people began arguing.
Medicine can go bad if it sits in the sun by the window for too long, so whenever the nurse saw someone leave it there carelessly, she immediately reminded them not to let it face the sun.

glosses.notes: A concise word for soldiers or troops, often seen in compounds such as 新兵, 老兵, and 士兵.

examples.sentence: 新兵到队里第一周最不习惯的不是早起，而是连吃饭和睡觉都得按同一个时间来。
老兵一看天气就知道晚上要下雨，所以吃完饭就催大家先把门口的东西收进去。
那张旧照片拍的是士兵刚下车的样子，旁边站着看的人很久都没有说话。

example_translations.translation: What the new soldier found hardest in his first week with the unit was not getting up early, but having to eat and sleep on the same schedule as everyone else.
The veteran could tell just by looking at the weather that it would rain that night, so as soon as dinner ended, he urged everyone to move the things at the door inside first.
That old photograph shows soldiers just getting out of the vehicle, and the people standing beside it looking on stayed silent for a long time.

glosses.notes: Can refer to a medical virus or a computer virus, depending on context.

examples.sentence: 医生说这种病毒传得快，可是只要大家一进门先洗手，再把窗户打开，风险就会小很多。
电脑突然坏了以后，大家先怀疑是不是中了病毒，所以谁也不敢再把自己的东西接上去试。
新闻刚说这里发现新病毒的时候，药店门口排队的人就一下子多了起来，连药也卖得特别快。

example_translations.translation: The doctor said this virus spreads quickly, but as long as everyone washes their hands as soon as they come in and keeps the windows open, the risk will be much lower.
After the computer suddenly broke, everyone first suspected it had a virus, so nobody dared plug in their own devices to test it.
As soon as the news said a new virus had been found here, the line outside the pharmacy suddenly got much longer, and even the medicine started selling very quickly.

glosses.notes: Means to broadcast or air news, programs, sound, or images.

examples.sentence: 每天早上电台先播天气，再播新闻，所以很多开车上班的人一到这个时间就把声音开大。
这段视频原来只是给店里用的，不料被人传出去以后，晚上新闻也把它播了一遍。
比赛刚结束，主持人还没来得及总结，现场大屏幕就先把最后那个关键镜头慢慢播给大家看了。

example_translations.translation: Every morning the radio station broadcasts the weather first and then the news, so a lot of people driving to work turn the volume up as soon as this time comes.
This video had originally been meant only for use inside the shop, but after someone shared it, the evening news broadcast it once as well.
The game had only just ended and the host had not even had time to summarize it yet when the big screen at the venue slowly replayed that final key shot for everyone.

glosses.notes: Used for sowing seeds in the ground before crops or plants grow.

examples.sentence: 雨刚停，村里几家人就一起下地播种，因为再晚几天，后面的收成多半会受影响。
老师带孩子们在院子角落播种以后，每天早上总有人先跑过去看今天是不是又冒出一点新绿。
这块地去年翻得不够深，今年播种前他们特意又请来机器，把最硬的那一层先松开了。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the rain stopped, several families in the village went out together to sow seeds, because if they waited a few more days, the harvest later on would probably be affected.
After the teacher had the children sow seeds in the corner of the yard, someone would run over every morning to see whether a little more green had appeared.
The ground had not been turned deeply enough last year, so before sowing this year they specially brought in a machine again to loosen the hardest layer first.

glosses.notes: A formal noun for a fair where companies or organizations show products, ideas, or achievements.

examples.sentence: 今年的博览会还没开门，门口就已经排了很长的队，很多外地来的参观者一早就赶过来了。
公司原来只想在博览会上看看别人怎么做，结果第一天下午就来了不少客人，只好临时找地方把东西摆出来。
她第一次去农业博览会，本来只打算陪父亲转一圈，后来却在卖机器的那一排问了很久价格。

example_translations.translation: This year's trade fair had not even opened yet, and there was already a long line at the entrance, with many visitors from other places arriving early in the morning.

The company had originally only wanted to see what others were doing at the exposition, but by the first afternoon quite a few customers had already come by, so they had to quickly find a spot and lay their things out.
It was her first time at an agricultural trade fair. She had only planned to walk around with her father once, but ended up asking about prices for a long time in the row selling machines.

glosses.notes: Describes something as weak or lacking strength, support, or a solid foundation.

examples.sentence: 他基础一直比较薄弱，所以别人半小时能做完的题，他常常得回去把前面的知识再翻一遍。
山里信号最薄弱的地方就在路口那边，司机每次开到那儿，电话里的声音就会一会儿有一会儿没有。
这家小店做饭不差，可是服务环节一直有点薄弱，忙起来的时候常常是谁点了什么都对不上。

example_translations.translation: His foundation is rather weak, so problems other people can finish in half an hour often send him back to review the earlier material again.
The place in the hills with the weakest signal is right by that intersection, and whenever the driver reaches it, the voice on the phone cuts in and out.
This little restaurant cooks well, but its service is still weak, and when it gets busy, they often cannot keep straight who ordered what.

glosses.notes: The common word for the neck as a body part.

examples.sentence: 他搬东西的时候太用力，晚上回家一动脖子就疼，只好先坐下来慢慢休息。
孩子在公园追球跑得一身汗，风一吹脖子就发冷，奶奶赶紧又把围巾给他系紧了一点。
医生看了看她脖子后面的红印，先问是不是新衣服太硬，再问是不是一直抓过那儿。

example_translations.translation: He used too much force while moving things, and by the time he got home his neck hurt whenever he moved it, so he had to sit down and rest slowly first.
The child ran around the park chasing a ball until he was sweaty all over, and when the wind hit, his neck felt cold, so Grandma quickly pulled his scarf tighter again.
The doctor looked at the red mark behind her neck and first asked whether her new clothes were too stiff, then whether she had kept scratching that spot.

glosses.notes: Describes losing patience and feeling annoyed about waiting or repeating something.

examples.sentence: 前面的人一直找不到证件，后面排队的年轻人已经有点不耐烦了，可是窗口里的工作人员还是慢慢解释。
她平时对孩子很有耐心，只有在别人问过三遍还不认真听的时候，脸上才会露出一点不耐烦。
我知道你急着走，可是你现在再不耐烦，也得先把事情听完，不然回头还是得重新问一遍。

example_translations.translation: The person in front kept failing to find their documents, and the young people waiting behind were already getting impatient, but the staff at the window still explained everything slowly.
She is usually very patient with children, and only when someone has asked three times without really listening does a trace of impatience appear on her face.
I know you are in a hurry to leave, but no matter how impatient you are now, you still have to hear the whole thing out, otherwise you will just have to ask all over again later.

glosses.notes: Means going ahead without paying attention to advice, danger, or consequences.

examples.sentence: 他明明刚退烧，却还是不顾医生的提醒，下午一开会就又在空调底下连坐了三个小时。
雨越下越大，送东西的人还是不顾路滑，先把老人要的药送到了门口。
她一听说孩子在车站走散了，什么行李都顾不上拿，转身就不顾一切地往广播室跑。

example_translations.translation: He had obviously only just recovered from a fever, yet he still disregarded the doctor's warning and sat under the air conditioner through a three-hour meeting that afternoon.
The rain was getting heavier and heavier, but the delivery worker still ignored the slippery road and took the medicine the older man needed to the door first.
As soon as she heard the child had gotten separated at the station, she grabbed no luggage at all and ran straight to the announcement room without thinking about anything else.

glosses.notes: Used to introduce an unexpected turn after what someone first thought or planned.

examples.sentence: 本来大家都以为这场会半小时就能结束，不料刚谈到最后一项，门外又送来一份新的通知。
他出门时天还很亮，不料走到桥边突然起风，雨一下子大得连对面的人都看不清。
我们原想先帮老人把东西搬上楼，不料钥匙忘在店里，只好又让一个人骑车回去拿。

example_translations.translation: Everyone had thought the meeting would end in half an hour, but unexpectedly a new notice was delivered just when they reached the last item.
It was still bright when he went out, but unexpectedly the wind picked up at the bridge and the rain suddenly became so heavy that he could not even see the people across from him clearly.
We had meant to help the older man carry his things upstairs first, but unexpectedly the key had been left in the shop, so one person had to cycle back to get it.

glosses.notes: Used for feeling physically unwell or uncomfortable.

examples.sentence: 她刚进会议室的时候只是脸色有点白，过了十分钟就明显觉得胃里不适，只好先出去透气。
新鞋看着合适，但是他穿着走路总觉得有些不适，所以第二天一早又回店里换了一次。
医生说如果吃完药以后还是不适，就别自己撑着上班了，最好下午再回来检查。

example_translations.translation: When she first entered the meeting room, her face was only a little pale, but ten minutes later she was clearly feeling stomach discomfort and had to step outside for some air.
The new shoes looked fine, but he always felt uncomfortable walking in them, so he went back to the store first thing the next morning to exchange them once.
The doctor said that if you still felt unwell after taking the medicine, you should stop forcing yourself to go to work and come back that afternoon for another check.

glosses.notes: Softens a judgment by saying things are not so extreme or are unlikely to go that far.

examples.sentence: 这件事确实麻烦，可是再怎么改也不至于忙到连回一条消息的时间都没有吧。
天气虽然冷了一些，但山上还不至于现在就下雪，所以导游还是按原计划带大家往上走。
你们只是意见不一样，还不至于为了这一顿饭闹得谁都不肯先坐下来吧。

example_translations.translation: This matter is definitely troublesome, but it still is not to the extent that you would be so busy you do not even have time to reply to a single message, right?
Although the weather has turned colder, it is still not to the extent that it would snow on the mountain yet, so the guide kept everyone to the original plan and led them upward.
You two only disagree with each other; it is not as if things are likely to get so bad that nobody will even sit down for this meal first.

glosses.notes: Can mean making up for what is missing, mending something, or building the body back up.

examples.sentence: 他前两天一直加班，周末本来想在家补一补睡眠，不料楼上从一早开始装修，谁也睡不成。
这件衣服破了一个小口，奶奶舍不得扔，找出一块旧布慢慢补好以后，又让我继续穿。
医生看完检查结果以后说她最近别只顾着减肥，先把饭好好吃够，把身体补好再谈别的。

example_translations.translation: He had been working overtime for the last two days and had planned to catch up on sleep at home over the weekend, but the upstairs apartment started renovating early in the morning and nobody could sleep.
There was a small tear in this piece of clothing, but Grandma could not bear to throw it away, so she found an old scrap of cloth, mended it slowly, and let me keep wearing it.
After looking at the test results, the doctor told her not to focus only on losing weight lately. She should eat enough first and build her body back up before worrying about anything else.

glosses.notes: Means catching or capturing, often in compounds such as 捕鱼, 追捕, and 捕捉.

examples.sentence: 天还没亮，几条小船就已经出海捕鱼了，因为再晚一点，市场里最好的位置就要被别人先占走。
警察在车站外面追捕了两个小时，最后才在一条小路上把逃跑的人按住。
为了捕捉海边日出的那几分钟，他前一天晚上就先去看地方，天一亮又带着架子跑回原位。

example_translations.translation: Before dawn, several small boats had already gone out to sea to catch fish, because if they went any later, the best spots in the market would be taken by others first.
The police spent two hours pursuing the fugitive outside the station before finally pinning him down on a small road.
To capture those few minutes of sunrise by the sea, he went to scout the place the night before, then ran back to the same spot with his camera stand as soon as it got light.

glosses.notes: Means giving money, goods, or something else in return to make up for a loss or inconvenience.

examples.sentence: 航班一下子晚了四个小时，航空公司后来虽然给了补偿，可是很多人还是错过了当天的转车。
这家店把客人的电脑修坏以后，不但重新买了一台新的，还主动提出再补偿一点钱。
老板知道周末把大家留下加班太久，所以月底发工资时又另外给了一些补偿。

example_translations.translation: The flight was delayed by four hours. Although the airline later offered compensation, many people still missed their connecting transport that day.
After the shop damaged the customer's computer, it not only bought a new one, but also offered to pay a little extra compensation.
The boss knew everyone had been kept working too long over the weekend, so when salaries were paid at the end of the month, he gave some extra compensation as well.

glosses.primary_gloss: to make up a missed lesson
glosses.notes: Used for making up a class that someone missed or that had to be postponed.

examples.meaning_en: to make up a missed lesson
examples.sentence: 他发烧请了两天假，周末只好回学校补课，不然下周一一上来就会听不懂老师在讲什么。

examples.meaning_en: to make up a missed lesson
examples.sentence: 这家培训班晚上总有人来补课，所以前台一到下班时间还得再把第二天的书先放好。
雨太大停课那天，老师没急着把进度往前赶，而是先挑了一个下午给全班统一补课。

example_translations.translation: He took two days off with a fever, so he had to go back to school over the weekend to make up the missed lessons, otherwise he would not understand what the teacher was talking about as soon as Monday started.
There are always people coming in at night to make up lessons at this training center, so as soon as closing time approaches, the front desk still has to put out the next day's books.
On the day classes were cancelled because of the heavy rain, the teacher did not rush the schedule forward, but instead picked an afternoon to have the whole class make up the lesson together.
